_doc: GROWTH-TG-QUOTA-PARITY-W1 CH4 — the MACHINE SoT for retired brand phrases.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: brand-facts.md has carried a 🛑 FORBIDDEN list since 2026-08-09.
Eighteen days later a census found the retired free-tier phrase still live in 21 vault files
and 9 repo files, including landing/llms-full.txt — the surface AI agents ingest. The list
did not fail because it was wrong; it failed because prose addressed to whoever happens to
read it is not a control. Per the Completeness Standard, a rule that has once failed as
prose must be retired into a gate or deleted, and this one is worth keeping.
THE SPLIT, and it is stated in BOTH files so neither can quietly claim the other's job:
brand-facts.md  is authoritative for RATIONALE — why a phrase was retired, what replaced
it, and every judgement a human needs to write good copy.
THIS FILE       is authoritative for ENFORCEMENT — the patterns scripts/check-forbidden-
phrases.mjs actually blocks. Nothing here explains; nothing there blocks.
Each entry carries `retired_on` and `superseded_by` so a hit tells the author what to write
INSTEAD, not merely that they are wrong. A gate that only says no gets muted.
_severity_contract: error = FAIL the gate. warn = report on stderr, verdict unaffected. Only 'error' blocks.

phrases.reason: PRICING-FLAT-CALL-BILLING-AND-6MONTH-W1 moved the free ladder. Canonical only from v1.10.3 → v1.25.x.
phrases.bare_token_na_reason: The retired figure is `100`, and `100` is a LIVE number: it is the free tier's per-UTC-day cap (FREE_DAILY_CALLS, src/lib/plans.ts) and a component of the live 100,000 Pro rung. Measured 2026-09-08: 530 corpus lines carry it. Enumerating it would put this gate at war with the copy it steers authors toward, which is how a gate gets warn-moded within a week. The `calls/month` unit noun is what makes the RETIRED sense identifiable, so the pattern is already the narrowest honest form.

phrases.reason: Same retirement as free-quota-100-per-month, in the shorthand form the FAQ used.
phrases.bare_token_na_reason: Same token and same collision as free-quota-100-per-month: the retired sense of `100` is not separable from the live one without the `/mo free` context the pattern already requires.

phrases.reason: The llms-full.txt FAQ phrasing of the same retired figure. Kept as its own entry because the generic pattern cannot see it — there is no unit noun beside the number.
phrases.bare_token_na_reason: Same token, same collision. Here the pattern carries the entire distinguishing context ('After 100, pay per call') precisely BECAUSE there is no unit noun beside the number — which is why enumeration cannot help: the bare figure IS the ambiguity.

phrases.reason: `20 calls/day` was the pre-v1.10.3 free daily cap. NARROWED 2026-08-27: the first cut bundled `100 calls/day` into this pattern and fired on the CANONICAL copy in docs/RUNBOOK-INTEGRATION-TUTORIAL-AUTHORING.md — a gate that fails on the phrasing it steers authors toward is one that gets warn-moded. The stale-monthly form (`100 calls/day` used AS the monthly figure) is caught by legacy-asset-gate, which sees the `BTC+ETH` it always travels with.
phrases.bare_token_na_reason: The retired figure is `20`, which is LIVE in at least two unrelated senses — the /api/webhooks rate limit of 20 req/min (src/lib/webhook-api.ts) and the published Skills count in README.md. Measured 2026-09-08: 144 corpus lines. The `calls/day` unit noun is the only thing that makes the retired sense identifiable.

phrases.bare_token_na_reason: SEMANTIC, not numeric. What was retired is an assertion ('no daily cap'), not a figure, so no token is narrower than the pattern itself.

phrases.reason: The free tier's coin/timeframe gate was removed in v1.10.3 FREE-UNLOCK-W1. Forbidden in brand-facts.md since 2026-08-09 and never enforced until now.
phrases.bare_token_na_reason: SEMANTIC, not numeric. The retired thing is a coverage claim ('BTC and ETH only') and the pattern already IS its narrowest form.

phrases.reason: The annual interval was ARCHIVED IN STRIPE — there is no annual plan to sell. PRICING-FLAT-CALL-BILLING-AND-6MONTH-W1.
phrases.bare_token_reason: GENUINELY ADDITIVE. The pattern requires the `/yr` suffix, so 'Starter was $79 a year' or 'the $79 tier' would sail past it. Measured 2026-09-08: 0 occurrences on the corpus. `$299` is DELIBERATELY not enumerated — it is simultaneously Pro's priceUsdAnnual and Enterprise's priceUsdMonthly in src/lib/plans.ts, so a bare `$299` cannot tell the retired annual list price from a live enforcement figure. Same live-collision that makes `100` and `20` unenumerable.

_pattern_history: The old form demanded the unit noun IMMEDIATELY after the figure, because it was transcribed
from brand-facts.md's phrasing ('3,000 calls' · '15,000 calls') rather than sampled from the
estate. Live copy rendered the ladder as a slash-delimited enumeration with the noun once, far
to the left — 'a pull call (Free 100 / Starter 3,000 / Pro 15,000 / Enterprise 100,000).' — so
the gate reported PASS over docs/WEBHOOKS.md, a file linked from EVERY webhook payload.
The widening is TIER-ANCHORED, not bare. A bare \b3,000\b was measured and REJECTED: it fires
on landing/llms-full.txt ('gates ≥85% and ≥3,000' — a shadow-mode sample-count threshold), which
is in the corpus and not exempt, so it would turn the gate RED on honest copy. \b anchoring also
does the work people expect of it here: '3,000' does not match inside '13,000' or '10,000', and
🛑 THIS FORM DELIBERATELY WILL NOT CATCH AN UN-TIERED FUTURE PHRASING ('the 3,000-call rung').
That gap is not an oversight and must not be patched by widening this regex until it collides
with live copy. It is covered by `bare_token` enumeration below, which is the GENERATOR fix:
detection by phrasing is strictly weaker than enumeration of the figure.
phrases.reason: The pre-flat-billing Starter/Pro rungs. Same ladder that leg L4 of the bot's seam gate bans in code.
phrases.bare_token_reason: GENUINELY ADDITIVE. The pattern requires a tier word or a unit noun NEAR the figure, so it is strictly narrower than the retired figure itself — and that gap is exactly what let `a pull call (Free 100 / Starter 3,000 / Pro 15,000 / Enterprise 100,000)` ship on docs/WEBHOOKS.md while the gate reported PASS. An un-tiered future phrasing ('the 3,000-call rung') is invisible to the pattern and is caught here. This is the entry that motivates the whole second pass.

bare_token_allowlist.reason: The line reads 'PFE Win Rate 92.42% across 3,959 evaluated samples; gates >=85% and >=3,000'. That 3,000 is the shadow-mode SAMPLE-COUNT threshold the 3m timeframe had to clear before joining the public track record — a statistics gate, not a call quota. It shares nothing with the retired Starter rung but its digits. Measured 2026-09-08: this is the SOLE unaccounted occurrence of either token across the whole 452-file corpus, which is why the allowlist is one row and not a policy.

phrases.reason: brand-facts.md: `algovault.com/pricing` returns 404 and must never be cited. The signup endpoint IS the pricing surface.
phrases.bare_token_reason: COEXTENSIVE WITH THE PATTERN TODAY, and recorded as such rather than sold as added reach. `algovault\.com/pricing\b` and this token accept the same strings, so the second pass here is always-accounted and finds nothing the primary pass would miss. Kept because it is evaluated on every run and holds the line if the pattern is ever narrowed — NOT because it widens coverage now. Measured 2026-09-08: 0 occurrences.

_negative_context_contract: negative_context: a regex tested against the SAME LINE. On a match the hit is SUPPRESSED and COUNTED, and the run prints the suppression total — 'detect the thing, then JUDGE it separately, and print what the predicate excludes'. This exists because a live surface may legitimately NAME a retired phrase in order to retire it: a README release recap saying '$79/yr … Superseded: annual was retired 2026-08-09', or an authoring runbook teaching 'never write 20 calls/day'. Deleting those sentences would destroy the record that the retirement happened, which is the opposite of what this gate exists for.
_bare_token_contract: bare_token: the retired FIGURE or IDENTIFIER in its narrowest unambiguous form, enumerated rather than pattern-matched. The second pass scans the SAME corpus for each token as a word-bounded literal and requires EVERY occurrence to be accounted for as exactly one of: (1) matched by this entry's own `pattern`; (2) suppressed by this entry's `negative_context` on that line — the primary pass already judged it, and duplicating that judgement in an allowlist row would put one decision in two places; (3) a `bare_token_allowlist` row whose `reason` is a sentence, optionally narrowed to one `token`. Anything else is a FAIL naming the file, the line and the token. WHY: detection is strictly weaker than enumeration — a pattern only ever sees the phrasings its author anticipated, and `retired-tier-quotas` reported PASS over a live falsehood for that reason. An entry with no narrower unambiguous token declares `bare_token_na_reason`; the omission is permitted, undeclared is not.
